newsitem.title: UK: Heywood surges after buy-back, div news.
newsitem.headline: Heywood surges after buy-back, div news.

text.p: Shares in Heywood Williams Group Plc rose 10-1/2p to 206p on Wednesday after the company revealed plans to buy back ten percent of its shares and said it would maintain its dividend.

"The buy-back will enhance earnings by about five percent and that has boosted the share price today and so has holding its dividend. There were some worries over that because of the stock's high yield. The price has been very weak recently," said one construction analyst.
Heywood also said profits for the half year rose to 21.8 million stg from 15.3 million. The dividend stayed at 5p per share.
